lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke enters the hotel. The lobby is empty.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Hello? Is anyone here?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: No response. Luke ventures further into the hotel.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: This is weird. Why would that person send me here?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke hears music coming from one of the rooms.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Maybe someone in there can help.

lines.speaker: guest
lines.text: Oh! A visitor! Come in, come in!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Hi, I'm looking for—

lines.speaker: guest
lines.text: The receptionist? Yeah, they're never around. But check this out!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The guest shows Luke an elaborate online shopping setup.

lines.speaker: guest
lines.text: I never have to go to stores anymore! Everything comes right to me!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: You... you can do that?

lines.speaker: guest
lines.text: Of course! It's way easier than dealing with crowds, checkout lines, all that nonsense.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: This could solve everything! I could order what I need and never go to Grocery Outlet!

lines.speaker: guest
lines.text: Exactly! Hey, you look tired. Want to crash here tonight? I've got an extra futon.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Really? That would be amazing!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That night, Luke dreams of a life without shopping, without fear.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke wakes up feeling strange, like something isn't right.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Thanks again for letting me stay. I should go.

lines.speaker: guest
lines.text: No problem! Good luck with... whatever it is you're doing.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I'm... I'm not even sure anymore.
